description: Tiered context escalation: read only packages that match task language. Do not load every doc by default.
content_policy: Repo summaries stay functional/process-only; no people rosters. Secrets stay on Confluence, not in JSON.

tiers.name: session_anchor
tiers.when: Substantive QA or multi-step work; always skim T0 first.
tiers.skip_deep_read_when: Trivial, explicitly local edits (e.g. scratch only under automation/temp/) with no product/QA/process context.

match_any_package.mcp_hint: Confluence: CT home (342168339) for space entry; XT home (402589545) for upstream platform, boards, demo hosts. Strip contacts/people from summaries.
Confluence: QAPORTAL page Corner (497097273) and descendants only—not the whole QA space unless user widens scope.

match_any_package.note: Open only the ref that matches the deliverable (e.g. TC vs Smart Checklist/coverage vs DR), not necessarily all three.

match_any_package.mcp_hint: Use Figma MCP if enabled in Cursor; paste figma.com links with node-id. Access matches the OAuth user’s file permissions.

automation/tools/yogi-tool/yogi_resolve.py for URL/page_id; yogi_snippet.py (REST + extract) for small snippet_text—avoid pasting full confluence_get_page bodies per tag. --storage-file accepts metadata.content.value (MCP). Extractor disambiguates duplicate keys (DEFINITION vs LINK). --follow --cookie --snippet for one-shot; exit 3 if key missing in storage.

Epic artifact: epics/<EPIC-KEY>/<EPIC-KEY>-ref.json; schema_version 3 adds sources.bitbucket_repo, implementation.hits (EPIC-PREP step 5b). Optional EPIC-PREP repo=; repo resolution: trigger > prior ref > docs/project.json bitbucket.default_repo. step 2b client_shell_impact (Corner Trader vs Adaptive per qa-project.json). requirements[]: snippet_status + snippet_failure_reason when snippet missing. epic-prep uses epics/<KEY>/temp/ then delete temp/. Yogi: yogi_resolve + yogi_snippet. Bitbucket: bitbucket_search_code capped (~8 queries); Stash DC repo token PROJECT_KEY/repo_slug (see docs/project.json bitbucket); code search may fail with 404—browse/list still valid. XT: cap ~8 xt_refs, XT home 402589545—no full page bodies in ref.

Requires -ref.json with client_shell_impact. Phase 7 merges epic-ref implementation.hits (epic_prep), dedupes, renumbers impl-001…, then Bitbucket search from matrix/snippets when repo resolved (COVERAGE repo= overrides ref and project.json bitbucket.default_repo). calculation_contract ladders, out_of_epic fork not in body, evidence-gated dimensions, per-surface lines (Adaptive when affected), epic_verification_focus + verification_role. focus= optional. Durable: -coverage.json + .md; delete epics/<KEY>/temp/ after run.

Jira jira_get_issue + jira_search (CRTQA, CRTBL, SUPXT, CAN per qa-project). Loads -ref.json and -coverage.json when on disk; emits -analysis.json + .md; optional append Known issue > to checks[].detail_lines with dedupe; include_closed=yes for closed regression anchors. delete epics/<KEY>/temp/ after run.

Requires -coverage.json. Phase 8a: bundle shells only. Phase 8b: one subprocess per bundle (e.g. Task generalPurpose)—MUST NOT one-shot all draft prose; prefer temp/test-prep-draft-<bundle_id>.json merge. Jira steps only from fetched fields. Emits -tests.json + -tests.md; authoring.subprocess_completed per bundle; no /temp/ in durable JSON. map_only=yes skips 8b. delete epics/<KEY>/temp/ after run.

Optional; requires -tests.json from TEST-PREP. user-mcp-playwright + optional postgres-ctqa (tunnel up). One subprocess per bundle for spec materialization; epics/<KEY>/tests/*.spec.ts + -test-exec.json; temp/test-exec-* then delete epics/<KEY>/temp/. No console/SSH/webbroker-only setup—blocked bundles unless include_blocked=yes.

tiers.name: external_truth
tiers.use: user-mcp-atlassian; optional Figma MCP (Cursor-configured) for figma.com URLs; optional postgres-ctqa MCP when global ~/.cursor/mcp.json includes postgres-ctqa and tunnel is up; optional user-mcp-playwright for TEST-EXEC UI steps
tiers.when: Jira issues, Confluence bodies, search, or live boards—after T0/T1 as needed. For Figma frame/layer links, use Figma MCP when installed (automation/docs/figma-mcp.md). For CTQA PostgreSQL exploration or TEST-EXEC DB checks, use postgres-ctqa after tunnel (automation/tools/tunnel/ctqa_pg.py) and global Cursor MCP—see .cursor/mcp/postgres-ctqa.mcp.json, automation/tools/tunnel/README.md, and .cursor/HOW-TO.md.
tiers.mcp_scope: Scope Atlassian searches using docs/project.json and docs/qa-project.json (CT, XT, QAPORTAL subtree rooted at 497097273).

rules: Do not read all JSON and ref files for every task; match keywords to one T1 package when possible.
After T1, use MCP for authoritative Atlassian content; do not invent ticket or page text.
Never copy passwords or secrets from Confluence into repo files.
When adding new durable docs or paths, update AGENTS.md, README.md, and this map per harness-maintenance rule.
